* `HealthcareService:location` - HealthcareService:location
* `InsurancePlan:coverage-area` - InsurancePlan:coverage-area
* `OrganizationAffiliation:location` - OrganizationAffiliation:location
* `PractitionerRole:location` - PractitionerRole:location

params.name: address
params.description: A (part of the) address of the location

params.name: address-city
params.description: A city specified in an address

params.name: address-postalcode
params.description: A state specified in an address

params.name: address-state
params.description: A postalCode specified in an address

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the location

params.name: near
params.description: Search for locations where the location.position is near to, or within a specified distance of, the provided coordinates expressed as [latitude]|[longitude]|[distance]|[units] (using the WGS84 datum, see notes). If the units are omitted, then kms should be assumed. If the distance is omitted, then the server can use its own discretion as to what distances should be considered near (and units are irrelevant) Servers may search using various techniques that might have differing accuracies, depending on implementation efficiency. Requires the near-distance parameter to be provided also

params.name: organization
params.description: The identity of the organization the location belong to.

params.name: partof
params.description: The id of the location that the matched one is physically part of.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of the location.

* `Organization:partof` - Organization:partof
* `Organization:endpoint` - Organization:endpoint
* `Organization:coverage-area` - Organization:coverage-area

params.name: _offset
params.description: Number of results to be offset

params.name: _revinclude
params.description:
Return resources filtered by the search results (E.g. Endpoint:Organization, HealthcareService:organization, InsurancePlan:administered-by (Not effective), InsurancePlan:owned-by (Not effective), PractitionerRole:organization, PractitionerRole:network, OrganizationAffiliation:primary-organization, OrganizationAffiliation:participating-organization)

* `Endpoint:organization` - Endpoint:organization
* `HealthcareService:organization` - HealthcareService:organization
* `InsurancePlan:administered-by` - InsurancePlan:administered-by
* `InsurancePlan:owned-by` - InsurancePlan:owned-by
* `OrganizationAffiliation:primary-organization` - OrganizationAffiliation:primary-organization
* `OrganizationAffiliation:participating-organization` - OrganizationAffiliation:participating-organization
* `PractitionerRole:organization` - PractitionerRole:organization
* `PractitionerRole:network` - PractitionerRole:network

params.name: address
params.description: Select organizations with the specified address (matches any of the string elements of an address) (case insensitive)

params.name: coverage-area
params.description: (Not effective due to lack of data) Select health insurance provider networks available in a region described by the specified location

params.name: endpoint
params.description: Select organizations with the specified endpoint (in terms of endpoint ID)

params.name: name
params.description: Select organizations with the specified name (matches any of portion of the name) (case insensitive)

params.name: partof
params.description: Select organizations that are part of the organization (in terms of organization ID)

params.name: type
params.description: Select organizations of the specified type (E.g. fac, prvgrp, ins, ntwk)
